coptic: Ⲡⲓϩ̀ⲙⲟⲧ ⲅⲁⲣ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲛⲟ̅ⲥ̅ Ⲓⲏ̅ⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭ̅ⲥ̅: ⲉϥⲉ̀ϣⲱⲡⲓ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲉⲕⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲟⲛ ⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ: ⲡⲁⲟ̅ⲥ̅ ⲛ̀ⲓⲱⲧ ⲉⲧⲧⲁⲓⲏⲟⲩⲧ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲣⲭⲏⲉ̀ⲣⲉⲩⲥ ⲡⲁⲡⲁ ⲁⲃⲃⲁ Ⲧⲁⲱⲁⲇⲣⲟⲥ.

translations.english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, be with your saintly spirit, my lord the honored father the high priest Papa Abba (Tawadros).
translations.arabic: نعمة ربنا يسوع المسيح تكون مع روحك الطاهرة، يا سيدي الأب المكرم رئيس الكهنة البابا أنبا تواضروس.

transliterations.english: Pi-ehmot ghar empenshois Ieesous Pi-ekhristos: efeshopi nem pekagion epnevma: pashois eniot ettaieeout enarshee-erevs papa abba Tawadros.

stanzas.coptic: ⲡⲁⲟ̅ⲥ̅ ⲛ̀ⲓⲱⲧ ⲉⲧⲧⲁⲓⲏⲟⲩⲧ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲣⲭⲏⲉ̀ⲣⲉⲩⲥ ⲡⲁⲡⲁ ⲁⲃⲃⲁ Ⲧⲁⲱⲁⲇⲣⲟⲥ.

translations.english: And our father the Metropolitan Abba Pachomios.

sung.english: And our father the Metropolitan Abba Youssef.

translations.english: And our father the Bishop Abba Moses.

sung.english: And our father the Bishop Abba Basil.

translations.english: And our father the Bishop Abba Rofael.

sung.english: And our father the Bishop Abba Gregory.

coptic: Ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲉⲛⲓⲟϯ ⲙ̀ⲙⲏⲧⲣⲟⲡⲟⲗⲓⲧⲏⲥ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛ̀ⲉ̀ⲡⲓⲥⲕⲟⲡⲟⲥ ⲛⲏⲉⲧϧⲏ ⲛⲉⲙⲁⲛ.

translations.english: And our fathers the metropolitans and the bishops who are with us.

transliterations.english: Nem nenioti emmeetropolitees nem nepiskopos neeetkhee nemman.

coptic: Ⲙⲁⲣⲉ ⲡⲓⲕ̀ⲗⲏⲣⲟⲥ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓⲗⲁⲟⲥ ⲧⲏⲣϥ: ⲟ̀ⲩϫⲁⲓ ϧⲉⲛ Ⲡⲟ̅ⲥ̅: ϫⲉ ⲁ̀ⲙⲏⲛ ⲉⲥⲉ̀ϣⲱⲡⲓ.

translations.english: May the clergy and all the people be safe in the Lord. Amen. So it shall be.
translations.arabic: فليكن الإكليروس وكل الشعب معافين في الرب. آمين يكون.

transliterations.english: Mare pi-ekleeros: nem pilaos teerf: ougai khen Epshois: je ameen eseshopi.
